name: @haddowg/json-api-smoke
description: Dual ESM/CJS resolution smoke for the built dist of @haddowg/json-api-client, -query and -angular, plus the codegen bin run through a node_modules/.bin symlink. Not published; not aliased to source — it resolves the published `exports` map + conditions against `dist`.
